text:
morgan: FYI post-rollout: a couple of customers reported repeated suggestion fragments in streaming responses (short prompts). small sample but reproduced in staging. need to decide triage: micro-release (server guard), client workaround, or backlog fix.
li: can we categorize as bug vs enhancement? Feels like regression -> bug. high visibility for demo customers.
devin: agree regression. quick notes: observed on opt-6.7b-quant, appears as duplicated early chunks. possible race in chunk-flush path.
sara: product tradeoff: micro-release costs cycle, but keeps demos safe. backlog fix would be more robust but later. what does PM think?
pm-jamie: classify as P1 regression for affected customers. recommend short-lived mitigation (server guard or client-side dedupe) + canary rollback if needed.
morgan: owners? timeline?
devin: I can ship a server-side guard to suppress identical consecutive chunks within 500ms window. estimate 3-4h end-to-end (code + canary). client snippet is trivial but not guaranteed for all SDKs.
li: suggestion: route affected customers to v1.3 snapshot at 10% for 24h while guard is canaried. minimizes risk.
pm-jamie: do we need a dashboard metric and a prompt bank for regression checks? yes. add dup_chunk_rate, p99_stream_latency.
ops-bot: note: created ticket INF-3499; canary template: `redwood deploy canary --from v1.3 --to acct-cohortA --percent 10`
sara: ok, decision path: 1) create prompt bank for streaming dedupe tests 2) canary route 10% -> v1.3 for affected customers 3) deploy server guard to remaining cohort 4) run 24h and decide rollback vs keep with guard.
morgan: I'm taking comms. will offer client dedupe snippet as stopgap.
devin: snippet for server guard (pseudo):
```
if (chunk.text === lastChunk.text && now - lastEmit < 500) {
  drop(chunk)
}
```
li: add dashboard and pager thresholds: dup_chunk_rate > 0.3% warn, >1% page.
pm-jamie: prioritize INF-3499 as hot micro-release in backlog grooming; mark related longer-term ticket PL-5010 for root cause and regression harness.
sara: OK. schedule: devin to push guard to canary today, li to configure dashboard, morgan to message customers. review decision in 24h at Tue 09:30. owners: devin (fix), li (monitoring), morgan (comms), jamie (prioritization).
morgan: summary posted to release notes and micro-release board. closing interim next-steps here.
devin: starting work now, will post canary link when ready.
(li posts: dashboard PR https://console.redwood/boards/INF-3499)
(reacts: :white_check_mark: from pm-jamie)
